title: Alert before the OpenAI account runs out of credits
description: 2026-10-12: every bot turn on development failed because the OpenAI account behind /chatticus/development/thin-turn/openai-api-key had no credits (HTTP 429 insufficient_quota, credit_balance_exhausted). PR 512 logs provider_failed lines and shows a specific reason. Still needed: an alert (or a daily check against the billing or usage API) so the account is topped up before bots stop; consider an auto-recharge setting on the account.
